component.title: The core IR contract: the frozen call-by-push-value substrate

section.title: The contract and its discipline
section.prose:
The core IR is the frozen coupling-point substrate of gandr: the value, computation, and stack node shapes the surface lowers into, the checker and the typing machine range over, the machine runs, and the metatheory states its theorems about. The core is call-by-push-value
with grades on the thunk modal, an effect row on the returner, first-class control stacks, identity and dependent-pair formers, declared-data nominal handles, and a predicative code universe. This component is the contract's home: it fixes the data shapes those rules range over and declares what is frozen, what is a staged extension point, and what is a decided-direction hook.

The shapes below are the frozen core : stable by declaration, so every lane can build against them concurrently. A change to a substrate shape is expensive to retrofit, so it is decided in the open — a backbone decision recorded in the plan of record until the decision index exists — never a unilateral edit inside one lane. Additions are extensions, landing at their named slot without reshaping the frozen fragment. Re-sync is periodic, on contract change, not continuous. And one source owns each fact: a typing rule lives in its home component while this contract owns the frozen-data view; drift between them is a tracker item, not a tolerated state.

Absorbed from the pre-reboot core-IR/type contract and rewritten against the realized reboot core: the implementation-status table is now the realization map below, the machine face names the sole driver honestly, and the conversion-firewall section carries the recorded staleness correction — dependent elimination is realized, so the firewall holds by shape, not by absence. Where this component and a ported doc-comment disagree, this component is the contract; the doc-comment has drifted.

section.title: The realization map
section.prose: The frozen fragment is realized across five reboot crates. Crate core-checker carries the checker, the defunctionalized typing machine, the type and term node families, subtyping, the grade carrier, the effect layer, the control fragment, the identity layer, and the host-seam types. Crate core-sequent carries the focusing translation and the L machine, the sole operational driver since the CEK oracle retired. Crates kernel-core and kernel-strata carry the certified-kernel slice: arena-resident terms, the universe-level algebra, and the quarantined structural conversion. Crate theory-levitation carries the description decoder whose codomain is the code universe.

section.prose: Two cores, two altitudes, one contract. The interpreter core (core-checker) realizes the full frozen fragment including the dependent formers; the certified kernel (kernel-core) is the deliberately smaller trusted slice — at its current stage it quarantines the dependent pair, the path type, effects, control, holes, and the list and record formers to its own later stage, so its conversion never descends into a term. The decl-table half of declared data (the constructor field types) is the data surface's job and stays adopted-unbuilt; the frozen core carries only the nominal tag and its arguments.

section.title: Polarity: two sorts and the adjunction
section.prose:
Two type sorts. A value type A (positive) is what is: it classifies values. A computation type B (negative) is what does: it classifies computations. The F ⊣ U adjunction connects them: U_r B is a value (a thunk of a computation), F^ε A is a computation (a returner of a value), and thunk/force and ret/>>= mediate. This is the cartesian-calf substrate shape
, with grades on U and an effect row on F as gandr's additions over the calf base. A third syntactic category, stacks (evaluation contexts), is internalized as the value type Stk(B, C); there is deliberately no value-level function type.

The adopted unifying semantic model is the wheeled, polarity-sorted, graded nominal PROP: a unification of already-adopted axes rather than a greenfield bet, built on the nominal substrate whose atom representation is filled by supported sets
— finite, serializable, bridging to de Bruijn. It reshapes none of the frozen shapes: a decided direction whose construction is the open obligation, pointed at here and homed in the theory crates.

section.prose:
Decomposition for structural subtyping is structural: products, sums, and lists covariant; the closed record {ℓᵢ:Aᵢ} width plus depth (a wider record is a subtype, each shared field covariant); the graded thunk contravariant in its grade (U_r B <: U_s B′ iff s ⊑ r and B <: B′). The path type Path A x y is the first dependent former — its endpoints are value terms — and is invariant in all three positions: the carrier by two-way subtyping, the endpoints under the no-reduction structural value equality (α-respecting, annotation-transparent, hole-consistent, with no reduction inside types). The declared-data handle D(ā) is
: its minted nominal id compares before any structural carrier, so two structurally-identical declarations are distinct types, with ā then covariant and positional and an empty ā consistent with any instantiation; the carrier itself lives in the decl table the data surface holds, not in the core type. The code universe Type is the predicative sort the description decoder targets
and the sort at which the dependent pair Σ(x:A). B binds its head: one predicative bump, reflexive-only in subtyping, with Type : Type refused by construction of the first-order fragment; the judgmental level algebra behind it lives in kernel-strata, and the frozen interpreter core carries the former without a first-class type-formation judgment. Σ's head is a small value type (a Σ over Type is families territory, outside the fragment); subtyping is invariant up to α-renaming of the binder. The gradual hole Unknown
is consistent with every type in both directions, so transitivity is deliberately not admissible once it participates — reflexivity stays admissible, never a node shape.

The function type A → B (value argument, computation result) is contravariant in the argument and covariant in the result; the lazy product B & B′ ("with") is componentwise; F^ε A decomposes to A <: A′ together with the row relation on ε. section.title: Grades on U
section.prose:
A grade counts how many times a thunk may be forced — a coeffect on U, the symmetric dual of the effect on F
. Grades appear in exactly one type constructor, U_r B, and in the term forms thunk_r t, dup, and drop; linearity is structural (the linear zone), never grade-policed — grades and the linear zone are independent disciplines. The algebra is a preordered semiring with default carrier ℕ ∪ {ω}, r ⊑ s iff r ≤ s or s = ω; + is alternative, accumulated demand, · nested, sequential demand.

The grade carrier is a single concrete, representation-sealed type, not a parameter: its entire surface is the semiring signature (constants 0/1/ω, constructor fin, order leq, algebra plus/times), rendered for diagnostics through Debug only, so swapping the semiring is a one-module edit and no IR node, frame, or error ever names a semiring parameter. An unannotated thunk elaborates to grade ω (U B ≡ U_ω B). The graded thunk is orthogonal to the effect row: U_r (F^ε A) reads "a thunk forceable r times of a computation that may do ε."

section.title: The effect row on F
section.prose: An effect signature E names a family of operations, each with a payload and a reply type; an effect row ε is a finite composition of signatures, ⟨⟩ | ⟨E | ε⟩, with a row variable reserved for polymorphism. Effects sit on F, the dual of grades on U: the implemented returner node carries the row inline, and the pure returner is the empty-row case. Signatures are environment-free — carried inline on the perform node, an operation named by identity, never captured as a closure.

Two presentations of the same row, both kept. The kernel presentation carries ε explicitly; the ambient presentation threads one implicit current row through the judgment, adjusted at handling positions — Frank's ambient ability
. The surface uses the ambient presentation; lowering is responsible for the ambient-to-kernel translation, and the checker and metatheory see the kernel. Row constraints are solved by deterministic Rémy-style row unification — a constraint domain, not a node shape. Sessions are not effects: session actions are structural, so session fidelity cannot be handled away — an effect operation may be implemented over a session, but a session action never appears in ε.

section.prose:
The native builtin native p v̄ is a Rust-backed builtin: an axiom typed by the primitive's declared type with its accumulated arguments peeled, and a function-like terminal that reduces in Rust once saturated; p is an opaque tag resolved in a registry, the same inline-name discipline as perform's operation — machine-minted names ride one nominal atom substrate
. Sequencing t >>= x. u is the sole union-elimination site by construction, and handlers and shift share one mechanism: the captured prefix is the stack handed to a clause.

The identity eliminator walk(p, (x y q). C, (x). c) is the sole primitive eliminator of the path type, in the full Martin-Löf form: the motive C is a computation type binding both endpoints and the path, the base c answers the diagonal, and both binder structures are part of the walk syntax form, like case arms. Its one computation rule is definitional β on here — walk(here(v), C, (x). c) ↦ c[v/x] — with no η and no K; a case on a path scrutinee is rejected with the without-K reservation diagnostic, and the Paulin-Mohring based variants are derived, never primitive. The split motive is the same discipline one rung down: split v as (x, y) [z. M] in t eliminates a product or a Σ-typed scrutinee, taking an optional dependent motive (z). M — motive-bearing infers (the body checks against M[(p,q)/z], delivering the outer-scoped M[v/z], so no binder escapes), motive-less is check-only — and the runtime is type-erased, so the machine runs a Σ-typed or motive-bearing split exactly as a product one and the checker–machine differentials cover it with no new evaluation rule.

A reified stack stk K is a value of type Stk(B, C), consumed by resume v t. The one-shot discipline is a typing-side property, not a node shape: a stack capturing linear-zone obligations is itself linear-zone-resident — discarding it without resume is a linearity error unless a discard runs the recorded unwind obligations, and duplication is permitted only when the captured zone is empty.

section.title: Contexts and the machine inventory
section.prose: The judgment ranges over a two-zone context Γ; Σ: Γ intuitionistic (world-annotated value hypotheses when worlds land), Σ linear — stack-owned obligations now, endpoints and capabilities when sessions land. In the realized core Σ is present but vacuous: no typing rule populates it yet, a conformance meta-invariant pins it empty across every run, and its one-shot laws are unit-tested directly.

section.title: Decided-direction hooks
section.prose: These features are decided directions built by no frozen-core node; each hook names the forward-compatibility slot the decided construction lands in, and each lands additively, without reshaping the frozen fragment. The slot mechanism is the same discipline that seals the grade carrier behind an upgrade path; what waits on the far side of each slot is a decided direction, not a reserved option.

section.title: The phase modality and the cost effect
section.prose:
The calf-lineage
phase modality (open and closed phases, with noninterference) and the primitive cost effect step^c — a cost-monoid-indexed effect on F, distinct from the U_r grade — are adopted as the tail's user-facing effects slot: tier-1 step^c on effect rows, a cost/behavior phase distinction with noninterference, and tier-2 erasure elaboration sharing the phase/relevance/erasure infrastructure with the erasure hook below. The directed refinement — an intrinsic preorder in which a cost bound is a program — rides the same design pass, with the directed cost-aware framework as its reference
. Both are distinct from the compilation-staging phase, from subtyping, and from the grade order.

section.title: The erasure functor
section.prose: The phase-erasure functor takes the dependent layer to its non-dependent shadow — this contract's shapes are that shadow. It is a meta-level map, not a node, and holds the tail's final slot; the kernel reserves trusted-code annotation slots for erasure and modes so the landing stays additive rather than a kernel-format rewrite.

section.title: The conversion firewall, corrected
section.prose:
The conversion firewall is the construction discipline the dependent layer inherits: three defaults answering the Fire-Triangle negative result — substitution, dependent elimination, and observable effects are jointly inconsistent
. Conversion does not observe effects: no conversion step evaluates an effectful F^ε A into a conversion-visible value, and F^ε stays abstract under conversion. Dependent indices are pure value types only: U_r (F^ε A) and Stk(B, C) are excluded from conversion-reaching index positions — polarity alone is insufficient, U_r B being itself a value type. And the conversion-relevant fragment exposes no full-dependent catch.

Correction, recorded at absorption. The pre-reboot contract asserted the core satisfied the three defaults by absence — no conversion, no dependent elimination. The absence claim is stale: the realized reboot core realizes dependent elimination directly, the
over a dependent motive and the
split, alongside the
and
formers. The firewall survives by shape, not by absence. Conversion is a
: in the interpreter core, value equality is α-respecting, annotation-transparent, and hole-consistent with no reduction inside types; in the certified kernel, definitional equality is an id-equality early-out plus α-structural equality plus canonical level equality, with no β law firing and no computation evaluated — and since no kernel type former is yet indexed by a value term, the effects quarantine holds vacuously there. Dependent elimination at the term level with a conversion that never evaluates is exactly the configuration the negative result permits; when a term-indexed type former lands in the kernel, the β laws of the value fragment become load-bearing, and the three defaults above are the discipline it is built under.

The data layer reads the core's datatypes as the Squier-degenerate — convergent — fragment of a
: sorts, constructors, and directed rewrites where higher coherence is automatic. That convergent slice is realized in crate theory-computads as the
engine; the untruncated directed higher-coherence tower is the adopted polygraphical-data direction whose coherence-computability vehicle is the sister internal-univalence formalization — a live in-house program, not a completed proof. The tower stays outside this frozen contract; the direction is decided, the tower is the work.
